name: Lai
source:
"The light in your eyes has not yet gone out."

Yvet's old detective acquaintance.
Formerly a detective, when he learned that his boss, Lau Ka Tung, was using Lycoris to assassinate him, he risked his life to bring the truth to light.
Lycoris was moved by his actions and saved his life. 
He is wary of The Ghost, who is hiding something from Yvet.
He is actually a half-brother to Francis and has a strong sense of justice due to his rebellious origins as the illegitimate son of the head of an underworld organization.
He is aloof and good-natured, and is a former colleague of Sam, Chase, and Fatso.
He enjoys cooking for himself.
He has a liking for Yvet and wants to help her.
